channel.title: Eswatini - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Eswatini, every source cited.

item.title: Police allege PUDEMO president coordinated 2021 unrest by phone
item.description: Mlungisi Makhanya and Zweli Martin Dlamini allegedly directed ground activities and received stolen firearms during the 2021-2023 unrest, according to court papers.

item.title: Eswatini attracts E1.85 billion in new investments
item.description: The Eswatini Investment Promotion Authority facilitated projects expected to create 147 jobs.

item.title: Court stops Eswatini National Provident Fund board inauguration
item.description: Business and labour federations challenged the appointment process, leading to an interim court order.

item.title: South African duo win Eswatini Ingwenyama Cup awards
item.description: Mandla Qhogi named Coach of the Tournament, Senzo Ndlovu Player of the Tournament.

item.title: Mbabane derby to decide Charity Cup
item.description: Mbabane Highlanders and Mbabane Swallows will clash in the PLE Charity Cup final on November 8.
